blocks.text: The reality of community management work

Your day as a community manager is a balancing act. You switch between moderation, project management, and reporting. This generalist approach makes it hard to stay focused on strategic goals. Research shows that many managers spend 60 to 70 percent of their time on manual data entry or repetitive administrative work. You are often buried in emails and manual requests like onboarding or status updates. These tasks derail your strategic planning and content creation time.
Your Mac app stack for community engagement

Most community managers prefer a small set of specialized apps on their Mac. This prevents account sprawl and helps maintain focus. You might use SupaSidebar to keep your brand accounts and browser profiles in separate spaces. This reduces the risk of posting to the wrong account. Rambox is another common choice for centralizing chat and email apps into one interface. This reduces your mental load when checking different channels.

items: Sprout Social or Hootsuite for monitoring and analytics
Buffer or Later for scheduling visual content
Circle or Mighty Networks for hosting private spaces
ChatGPT or Copy.ai for drafting replies

blocks.text: How Lazur helps you manage your day

Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. It sees your screen and hears you when you hold the shortcut. You can hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything visible on your screen. Lazur will answer out loud. If you need to find a specific setting in a complex dashboard, ask Lazur where it is. It will draw a circle around the button for you. If you are stuck on a process, ask Lazur how to do it. It will guide you one click at a time.

Community management requires a lot of writing. You need to draft responses that sound human and helpful. Hold the fn key to dictate text directly into your cursor. Lazur formats this text for you. If you need to research a new platform or a trend, use the research capability. Lazur will open its own Chrome tabs, perform the research, and return a summary to you. This saves you from having to hop between tabs manually.

Your privacy matters. Lazur only listens and looks at your screen when you hold the shortcut. Audio and screenshots are sent to AI providers to answer your questions and are not stored. Your content is never used to train AI models. If you work in a regulated field, remember to follow your employer's rules regarding client or patient data. Do not share sensitive information with any AI tool.

faq.question: Can Lazur post content to my social media accounts?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate apps for you. It can guide you through the process or help you draft your post, but you must perform the final action.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on Windows?
faq.answer: Lazur is currently available only for macOS on Apple silicon and Intel. A Windows version is planned but not available.

faq.question: How much does Lazur cost?
faq.answer: Lazur offers a 3-day Pro trial. Pro plans start at $18 per month or $15 per month billed annually. Power plans start at $120 per month or $96 per month annually.
